error_definitions.scope: Separate mutually exclusive FP and FN partitions at source eight-type IoU=.5. A confusion/localization event can contribute one FP and one FN; do not sum these as unique physical events.
fp_priority_order: duplicate: same-class IoU>=.5 to already TP-matched GT
confusion: otherwise different-class IoU>=.5 to any GT
localization: otherwise same-class .1<=IoU<.5 to any GT
error_definitions.matching: Confidence-descending one-to-one same-class greedy TP, highest IoU then stable GT index; equal confidence keeps exported prediction order.
error_definitions.diagnostic_links: Links may reuse objects and are explanatory, not additional TP assignments. Each FP or FN is assigned exactly one category by the stated priority.

parent_data_findings.evidence: summary.json, computed only from completed s30 parent640/832 validation exports and frozen manifest metadata

largest_recall_loss_parent640.interpretation: Operational misses are 69.8% of FN, larger than localization (17.7%) and type-confusion (12.4%) diagnostics. Missed means no same-class localization or high-IoU wrong-class link at this operating point, not proof the image contains no low-confidence candidate.

largest_precision_loss_parent640.interpretation: Background accounts for 48.6% of FP. These can include road texture/other scene features or possible annotation incompleteness; no annotation defect is confirmed.

relaxed_diagnostics_parent640.interpretation: Most localized wrong-type pairs (156/198) are subtype disagreements. Even ignoring class at IoU0.3 yields recall1667/2623=63.6% at confidence0.25; box/type relaxation alone does not reach70% at this point. These matchings use different greedy assignments, so increments are diagnostic and must not be added as disjoint causal contributions.

rare_class_support.interpretation: Transverse-wide, sunken-alligator and deep-pothole have243/311/193 original training boxes versus4556 longitudinal boxes. Their original supporting group counts are230/288/157, not twice as many independent samples because mirrors double effective counts. This is substantial imbalance and a plausible limitation, but the current observational evidence does not prove training data is sufficient or insufficient for70%.

size_association_parent640.interpretation: Smaller annotated objects are associated with more misses; this is image-space geometry and not an engineering size measurement. No contrast metadata was available and no contrast claim was made.

resolution_only_parent832.interpretation: Increasing inference resolution of the same640-trained parent to832 did not improve recall: all four country recall values fell, and TP fell1343->1241. This does not predict the result of the new832 fine-tune.

visual_review.selection: Class/category round-robin among high-confidence FP background/confusion; directed examples, not a random sample
visual_review.observations: Existing comparisons visibly include wide predicted boxes covering road/shadow texture and ordinary-versus-wide/sunken label disagreements. Exact source-type correctness and missing annotations were not independently verified; no labels were changed.

parent_data_findings.claim_scope: Validation-tuned parent diagnostics only; no test images/labels, GPU, new inference or training output reads. Tracked source remains frozen.

plot_visual_review.notes: Viewed both figures: readable axes/legends/captions; same-threshold candidate points and separate IoU diagnostic panel; both-70 target visibly unmet.

limitations: One seed and one 40-epoch fine-tuning trial; no estimate of training variance or causal parameter attribution.
All quality figures are validation-tuned; validation already participated in training and selection. No unseen test or Singapore generalization claim.
Primary target requires both correct-eight-type precision and recall at the same global threshold and IoU .5. Secondary .3/family/agnostic metrics do not satisfy it.
Overall target does not imply all eight classes satisfy it; rare-class support and macro scores remain visible.
HTTP acceptance proves integration only; real detections require review and business rules remain demo.
Selected manifest is local opt-in; no running backend or PyCharm configuration changed.
Dataset, weights, source images, prediction exports, databases and detailed logs remain ignored and are not published.
